card.name: Prepositions before scale or amount phrases
card.fires_on: Small prepositions (on, in, at, with, of) that come right before a phrase about size, scale, amount or concentration, such as "very small scales", "low concentrations" or "different temperatures".

modes.label: After only/even
modes.description: A preposition after "only" or "even" that introduces a small or low amount.
modes.example: this strange phenomenon had previously been thought to occur only<< on>> very small scales.

modes.label: Before a condition
modes.description: A preposition linking a thing to a measured condition or property, such as a temperature, surface or size.
modes.example: The researchers measured the ease with which the magnetic moments aligned with the field<< at>> different temperatures.
